en.title: Count Integer Sequences
en.description:
Count the integer sequences of length N where each element can be 0..M and the bitwise XOR of all elements equals X. Output the answer modulo 998244353. Choices at different indices make different sequences.

The standard input/output format and supplementary constraints stated by this site belong to the definition of the online version and do not pose as the source's original constraints.
en.input: Input N M X; this site adds 1≤N≤100, 0≤M≤50, 0≤X≤63.
en.output: Output the number of sequences modulo 998244353.
en.explanation: Maintain a DP over XOR states 0..63. Each time an element is added, transition every old state to old XOR value, where value∈[0,M].
